evals.prompt: Deep council: should the company move the main product from its current host to a new cloud provider this month? The current box costs about 40 euros a month. Someone said the cloud provider would be cheaper at our scale. The team is one founder plus agents. Give me a confidence percentage at the end.
evals.expected_output: Evidence brief, author position, three independent helper voices (deep), synthesis.
expectations: An evidence brief before the voices with given, verified, assumed, unknown and value groups
The author's position is written before the voices
Deep mode: three helper voices that saw only the question and the brief
Synthesis shows the strongest dissent and says whether the council changed the recommendation
The percentage follows the confidence rule: facts tagged, and with no verified fact, 'No percentage: nothing here is verified' plus the check
A council ledger line and a confidence ledger line were appended

evals.prompt: Go/no-go: turn on the new odds alert for all members tonight? It was tested on two accounts.
evals.expected_output: Deep council (go/no-go on a release); recommendation only, release stays with the owner.
expectations: Leaves the release decision with the owner and the release coordinator
